provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Sounds of the alphabet
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state each letter sound.
The pupils should be able to match letters to pictures.
Introduction:
Today we learn sounds of letters. We know A B C D.
Content:
Say each letter sound. A says a. B says b. C says c. D says d.
Match letter to picture. A is for apple. B is for ball.
Class activity:
Teacher shows letters. Pupils say sounds.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does A make?
What picture matches B?
Can you say all letter sounds?
Summary:
We learned letter sounds and matching pictures.

topics.title: Phonics: a and b words
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to list a and b words.
The pupils should be able to say and point to pictures.
Introduction:
We know A and B sounds. Today we learn words with these sounds.
Content:
A words: ant, apple. B words: ball, bat.
Say each word. Point to the picture of each word.
Class activity:
Teacher says a word. Pupils point to the correct picture.
Evaluation questions:
What word starts with A sound?
What is the B word for a game?
Can you say all four words?
Summary:
We learned a and b words with pictures.

topics.title: Phonics: c and d words
topics.content:

The pupils should be able to say and point to pictures.
Introduction:
We know C and D sounds. Today we learn words with these sounds.
Content:

Class activity:

Evaluation questions:
What word starts with C sound?
What is the D word for a house?
Can you say all four words?
Summary:
We learned c and d words with pictures.

topics.title: Rhymes: simple songs
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to sing letter songs.
The pupils should be able to clap the beat.
Introduction:
Today we sing songs about letters. We know A B C D.
Content:
Sing letter songs. Clap the beat. ABC song is fun.
Class activity:
Teacher sings a song. Pupils repeat and clap.
Evaluation questions:
What song did we sing today?
Can you clap the beat?
What letters did we sing about?
Summary:
We sang letter songs and clapped the beat.

topics.title: Picture reading
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name things in the picture.
The pupils should be able to say simple sentences.
Introduction:\ Today we look at pictures and name things. We know many words.
Content:
Name things in the picture. Say simple sentences about the picture.
Class activity:
Teacher shows a picture. Pupils name things and make sentences.
Evaluation questions:
What is in the picture?
Can you make a sentence about the picture?
What did you see in the picture?
Summary:
We learned to name things and make sentences.

topics.title: Writing: patterns and strokes
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify standing and sleeping lines.
The pupils should be able to trace patterns.
Introduction:
Today we learn to write lines. We know straight lines.
Content:
Standing lines go up and down. Sleeping lines go across.
Trace the patterns on the board.
Class activity:
Pupils trace patterns in their books.
Evaluation questions:
What is a standing line?
What is a sleeping line?
Can you trace the pattern?
Summary:
We learned to trace standing and sleeping lines.

topics.title: Writing: capital letters A to J
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to trace and copy letters.
The pupils should be able to say each letter name.
Introduction:
Today we write capital letters. We know A B C.
Content:
Trace and copy letters A to J. Say each letter name.
Class activity:
Pupils trace letters in their books.
Evaluation questions:
What letter comes after C?
Can you trace letter F?
Say all letters from A to J.
Summary:
We learned to write capital letters A to J.

topics.title: Revision and assessment
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recall letter sounds.
The pupils should be able to complete written tasks.
Introduction:
Today we revise what we learned. We know sounds and letters.
Content:
Sounds and letters review. Oral and written quiz.
Class activity:
Teacher asks questions. Pupils write answers.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does G make?
Write letter H.
Name three words you learned.
Summary:
We revised sounds and letters.
